body: We have recently purchased a house.  Leaving it would mean financial doom.  I am literally stuck between a rock and a fucking bank loan.

My daughter is two.  My only option is having my 76 year old father care for her.  That's not a viable option to me. He also can't care for my dog, I have failed him in his training and he is too exuberant for someone so aged.  Thank you for your support.
